title: National and local authority population estimates
description: ONS mid-year population estimates at UK and England & Wales level, plus their long historical back series (1838 onward) and detailed annual back series by local authority from 2011. Distinct from the electoral-ward estimates in the sibling 'population' dataset.

files.note: Mid-2024 UK population estimates. Direct file: https://www.ons.gov.uk/file?uri=/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates/datasets/populationestimatesforukenglandandwalesscotlandandnorthernireland/mid2024/mye24tablesuk.xlsx
